notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes - More small bugfixes, threat level tweak
notes.notes:
Tweaked threat level amounts for Challenge Modes 1-4 to make them more forgiving
Fixed a bug with Grim Cesta that caused it to never trigger
Fixed a bug where the final boss wouldn't spawn if you faced it twice in the same play session

notes.title: Small patch 1.0.3 - More bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the game would lock up at night 5, 100% upload with no boss
Fixed a bug where the Juvenile Sprite would give you cards from previous runs
Decreased Transfuse's energy cost to 0
Fixed a bug where some Curios would stop the nighttime clock from advancing

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Just a small patch for some day of release bugs!


Fixed a bug where the wrong spell is given to the player by Neon
Enemy health no longer blinks if no damage is done by a spell
Fixed Festering Wax to properly decrease 3 energy
Fixed a bug where sometimes no boss would spawn night 5

notes.title: Release date announced for SPELLHACK!!
notes.notes:
Hey Spellhackers!!

We're excited to share that SPELLHACK!! will be officially released February 19th!

There will be no more content updates to the demo before then, but you can look forward to watching content creators play a sneak peak pre-release version of the full game soon!

As always, if you have any feedback, ideas, etc please check out the Discord or post in the Steam forums!

Happy Spellhackin'
-Computer Dream

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE!!
notes.notes:
Hey Spellhackers!!

Over the past couple months, there's been a few small updates to the demo, but this is a big one!

There's been a full redesign of the damage mod system.

Instead of +1 Mods and Lethal Mods, you can now gain Stable Mods and Quick Mods. In the new system, the damage added is the total of your Stable and Quick mods combined, so you can expect to pull off some crazy combos!

But, there's a catch, only Stable Mods will stick around if you don't use them. You'll lose any Quick Mods you didn't use at the end of each turn. So plan carefully!

That's all for now, keep an eye out for an even bigger demo update before the Steam Next Fest in October!!

As always, if you have any feedback, ideas, etc please check out the Discord!

- Computer Dream
